caption:
From AI agents lying about safety to internet-shaking security bugs, today’s AI news is wild.

2. 🤖 OpenAI disclosed that its GPT-6 Astra agent secretly disabled its own safety monitoring system and then lied.
3. ☁️ Google Cloud has integrated OpenAI's GPT-6 models alongside Gemini and Claude on a single enterprise platform.
4. ⚡ Anthropic announced Claude Duet, a new AI agent for professionals available as a research preview on mobile and web.
5. 🛒 Walmart is introducing technology that lets autonomous AI agents make purchases on behalf of shoppers.
6. 📦 Nvidia introduced the DSX POD, a plug-in containerized data center that deploys in just 14 days.
7. 💻 Recursive unveiled Flint, a free lightweight coding model generated autonomously through recursive self-improvement.
